description: This file declares the MediaKeysClient class, which implements the IMediaKeysClient interface for handling media key events such as license requests, renewals, and key status changes within the Rialto media server IPC component.

classes.name: MediaKeysClient
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeysClient interface to handle media key events and communicate via IPC.

methods.name: MediaKeysClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media keys handle and IPC client.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events with session ID, message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events with session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles key status change events with session ID and key statuses.
